data.summary: Added a sixth ProblemCode constant STALE plus a Problem.stale(...) factory whose message quotes the requestedAt instant and maxAge.toDays(). WorkRequestValidator gained a (Clock, Duration) constructor (null-checked, minimum one day) alongside the preserved no-arg constructor; it reads clock.instant() once per validate call and rejects requests strictly older than now.minus(maxAge) only after all field checks pass, adding a "<requestId> rejected: stale" trace note and keeping them out of the queue. Wired it up with a new StalenessProperties record bound to app.staleness and a new Clock bean in ProcessingConfig; BatchObserver already registers one counter per ProblemCode, so STALE is covered automatically.
uncertainties: application.yml contents were not shown, so I could not add the explicit app.staleness.max-age: 30d default there; @DefaultValue("30d") still binds 30 days with no property set.
OrderIndependenceTest's problem-code generator was not shown, so it may need a stale request added to keep covering every ProblemCode.
